change: Keep geometrically distinct single-group moves before pair generation. Coincident corner aliases retain their first representative; pose, face, mirror and rotation differences remain. Existing candidate qualification still executes; this removes redundant pair inputs, not hardware checks.
tests: Orientation contracts cover candidate identity, distinct equal-envelope layouts, group rotations and pair combinations; a new incremental pair-input alias test covers first-representative preservation. Both-board diagnostic controls retain their exact qualified PCB hashes.

controls.result: Fanout, ratsnest, placement-contract and flow diagnostics pass; hard_red=0; zero nonsearch fallbacks. No new full qualification.

prechange_failed_screens.result: All exhausted bounded packing with four completed outer attempts and available failure receipts. Expanded rotation run used the pre-dedup executable and overlapped later build/tests; diagnostic times are not controlled speed comparisons.

bottom_side_findings: Whole-sheet bottom eligibility rejects seated connector classes and impedance-controlled nets without an emitted bottom reference plane. Mixed-face group generation instead pins service/through-hole/high-speed members and offers eligible independent contract groups. Envelope-area ranking does not measure face-specific free-space fragmentation, which remains a useful next investigation.
limitations: No runtime speedup quantified for dedup; no smaller board accepted. The expensive expanded-rotation campaign is not promoted to the standard recipe. Routing and fabrication readiness remain out of scope.
